page.layout: One page of text; a column of handwritten marginal annotations in the left and right margins (not transcribed). Running head at top; page number at top left.

main_text.p: Venentur cura quod abeft,nimioque labore Longinquam repetant saxosis montibus escam, Dum præsente frui negat his obliuio cæca.

O vtinam bipedes humano nomine Lynces, Non idem coqueret grauior vel morbus auaros: Quos vt parto venis vetat abditus hydrops: Et labor improbior stimulat,per saxa,per vndas Quærere,queis careant miseri,abstinéantque repertis.
main_text.head: Albario opere teftum adificium.Sofisoqoi.
main_text.p: Incruftata vides lutceæ qui mœnia molis Et gypso & niuea calce nitere procul: Forte putas si quid saxo durabile structum, Falleris,imponit candidus iste color.
Tu quoque, qui, (Sophiæ vocitat quos Græcia Patres Dum legis) exclamas térque quatérque Sophos! Si sapiens horum speras euadere dictis: Falleris:hinc surgit nil nisi mente tumor.
main_text.head: Amelum sive Aster, & Lupus falisiarius herba. Non nomina,sed res spectare oportet.
main_text.p: Non quia splendenti vocitatur Amelus ab Astro, Idcirco clarae munera lucis habet.
Nec timidis quibus stirps est metuenda vel agnis, Cui confert nomen bestia sæua lupus.
Nil nomen prodest vel obest.Nam rebus ab ipsis, Quod decorat vere dedecoratque,venit.
main_text.head: Christianorum ornamentum manfuetudo & clementia.

page.notes: Marginal annotations in the margins are handwritten and were not transcribed. Several words in the lower lines are faint; the catchword "Lactea" is printed at the right foot. Some Greek words in the heading ("Sofisoqoi") are doubtful.
